boundary: Unsigned public reads only: MetaMask's three public relay network lists and eth_getCode, eth_getStorageAt and eth_call on two public BNB Smart Chain RPCs, every chain read pinned by block hash with requireCanonical. No account, session, bearer token, fee quote, signature or payment. MetaMask's fee-token list for chain 56 needs a session and is checked by APN at each quote.
